trigger.excluded_note: A denied or unreadable leg is a not_met clause with a reason, hence a remnant: the executor makes it observable.

remnant.emitted_when: a not_met carries remnant when the gap is actionable; absent means the manual re-judge route; never on met

judge.role: emits the remnant object; never performs the remnant work

rejudge.at: the new HEAD after the remnant commits

commit_gates.review_receipt: remnant commits pass the review receipt

terminal_fallback.route: manual re-judge route (terminal-judge wiki, Closing a plan whose run judged not_met)
applies_when: the emitter has no remnant wave
